action.query:
SELECT 
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN IS_CANCELLED THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS CANCELLATION_RATE_PERCENT
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
action.reason: Metricflow failed; switching to SQL to calculate cancellation rate for 2025 using recorded order date.

action.answer: The cancellation rate for all recorded orders in 2025 was 5.997009%. This means that out of all orders placed in 2025 (using the recorded order date), approximately 6 out of every 100 orders were cancelled.
